title: The marker is guessed from the rows, so Stream::continued can write appended rows two characters off
body: Head::schema (src/read.rs:276-280) takes a table as Marker::Indent when every row opens with two spaces; Reader::new decides from the first row. A Marker::Absorb table whose first cells are all right-aligned and shorter than their column reads the same way. The cells read correctly, but a Stream::continued built from the parsed schema, as examples/read.rs:43 does, writes its rows two characters off. Rare, and left open at 0.3.0.
